units.canonical_text: Direct Connect is primary; a separate internet IPsec VPN is the recovery path. Do not assume the backup has the same capacity or that the two paths share the same failure boundary.
units.speech_text: Direct Connect is primary; a separate internet eye, pee, seck V P N is the recovery path. Do not assume the backup has the same capacity or that the two paths share the same failure boundary.

units.canonical_text: Site-to-Site IPsec protects packets between the VPN gateways. Its protection ends at those gateways. It doesn't, by itself, protect every application hop outside that tunnel.
units.speech_text: Site-to-Site eye, pee, seck protects packets between the V P N gateways. Its protection ends at those gateways. It doesn't, by itself, protect every application hop outside that tunnel.

units.canonical_text: A private IP Site-to-Site VPN can run over Direct Connect. In this picture, a transit virtual interface and Direct Connect gateway connect to the Transit Gateway, giving the private VPN endpoints a transport path. The IPsec overlay protects workload traffic through the tunnel.
units.speech_text: A private I P Site-to-Site V P N can run over Direct Connect. In this picture, a transit virtual interface and Direct Connect gateway connect to the Transit Gateway, giving the private V P N endpoints a transport path. The eye, pee, seck overlay protects workload traffic through the tunnel.

units.canonical_text: The recovery path sends approved summaries through the factory router. Direct Connect is primary; an IPsec VPN is the backup route to the regional pipeline and recovery replica. Use TLS for application and ingestion traffic. A private circuit does not by itself provide that encryption.

units.canonical_text: The designs differ in addressing and the virtual interface used. In both, Direct Connect supplies transport and IPsec encrypts traffic between the VPN endpoints.

units.canonical_text: The customer gateway device has two IPsec tunnels, both Up. The customer gateway resource represents the on-premises device. Use a virtual private gateway for supported single VPC designs, or Transit Gateway for centralized routing across multiple networks.
